paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +2.39% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+6.46%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.45%). Brent crude changed -2.52% to 95.84. Gold changed -4.63% to 3,886.3. Bitcoin changed -11.81% to 65,011.1797. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.154%, a relative move of +6.07%. Among the firms tracked, Invesco (+7.61%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (-6.80%) moved the most.
